title: Location seat resolution and the claimant index
summary: @inventarch/graph indexes path selections once per load. Graph gains claims, one Claim {from, field, selection, source} for each text value a record states in authority.covers, subject.covers, work.covers, hook.paths or check.scope (the list is exported as CLAIM_FIELDS), and referencesFrom, the typed field references keyed by holder; directedView reads referencesFrom instead of scanning every reference, and its output is unchanged. selects(selection, path) implements one path-selection dialect: workspace-relative segments separated by /, ** as a whole segment for any number of segments (none included), * for any run of characters within one segment, ? for one character, a trailing / for the directory and everything below it, and an exact path otherwise; matching is case-sensitive, a backslash reads as /, and there are no braces, classes, escapes or negation. An empty, absolute or non-canonical selection, and any path that is absolute or escapes the workspace, select nothing. isSelection(selection) says whether the dialect reads a selection at all. claimants(graph, path, scope) returns the records whose selections select a path as Claimant {identity, band, matches}, band descending then identity ascending, with every matching field and selection. The @inventarch/db readers (Handle, ReadHandle and the editor reader) add resolveSeat(path, options), which returns a SeatResolution {path, seat, by, claimants, unknown}: the seat is the admitted `@system` of the system folder holding the path (the floor's for .ia/src/floor), else the `@workspace` declaring the longest sources root that contains it, else, for a path in no .ia tree, the repository's own `@workspace` (the one in .ia/src that declares a root, else the only one there). With no seat, unknown reads undeclared, or outside for a path that is absolute or escapes the workspace. Options bind as get binds them, and a scope token prunes the seat and the claimants. The readers also add inertDeclarations(options), which names, with its record, field, value, path, line and reason, each declaration that declares nothing: a composition.sources entry of an admitted `@workspace` that names no root, and a claimant selection the dialect does not read (absolute, ./ or with an empty or .. segment), which selects no path; they are not admission findings. @inventarch/distribution's workspace session adds validation(), admission's findings with an IA-COMP-FIELD-VALUE warning at the line of each such declaration, in the report's order, and validateWorkspace returns it; ia validate, ia capture and ia-distribution validate all report that one finding set, and ia doctor counts its warnings, so such a typo is seen where it is authored. The session's admission() and the ia compile artifact are unchanged. The @inventarch/cli SPEC states the dialect; no ia command resolves a path yet, and the frozen Door routes and ia scope are unchanged. Workspace revisions and per-record digests are unchanged; the .ia/.iadb/graph.json cache payload gains the two indexes, so an existing cache file is rewritten on the next open.
